title: Answer from the menu bar
tags: The joys of a Mac app

options.label: A count, and a popover to answer the next card
options.act: MenuBarExtra(.window): count / waiting dot; popover with next card, 1–3, note, Open in Review
options.then: Add a menu-bar count and a popover that answers the next card.

options.label: Just the count; clicking opens the Review window

why: Most cards are two-way doors that take five seconds. The menu bar (already planned: plans/03-m5-remaining.md) shows a number only when something waits, and a quiet dot when an agent is waiting. Click it and a popover (MenuBarExtra, window style) shows the next card: its question, my pick, 1–3 to answer, a line for a note, and Open in Review. Answer, and the next one slides in.
That's Fantastical's menu-bar calendar and Things' Quick Entry: a whole small app in a popover, gone again when you click away.
